messages:
julia_cs: Heads up — ACME reported that org-level latency dashboards show p95/p99 lines gone after last night's telemetry proxy rollout. Route-level panels still show tails. Customer: acme-co (tenant-id: tn_acme_42). Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/acme-co/latency

kevin_oncall: thanks. can you paste a screenshot or the panel id? is it only org view or across all orgs?

julia_cs: screenshot pasted. Panel id: latency-insights-org-01. Repro steps: Console -> Org view -> Latency Insights -> Time range 6h -> p95/p99 curves blank (legend still lists p95/p99). If I switch to a single route the lines appear.

ingest-bot: Deploy: telemetry-proxy v2.13.0 rolled to prod @ 2312342000 by ci/cd-bot. changelog: tag-remap default ON.

sam_runtime: likely cause — the proxy rollout enabled tag remapping that drops org_tag for aggregated telemetry. That would remove grouping used to compute org-level quantiles. Can someone check the proxy config: `TAG_REMAPPING=true` / `DROP_ORG_TAGS=true`?

kevin_oncall: sam — where would I check quickly? kubectl access?

sam_runtime: `kubectl -n telemetry get configmap proxy-config -o yaml` then look for `dropOrgTags` or `strip_org` keys. Also we can query clickhouse to see if metrics for tenant are present: `SELECT count() FROM metrics WHERE tenant_id='tn_acme_42' AND metric_name='latency.p95' AND timestamp > now() - 3600`

kevin_oncall: running checks now...

kevin_oncall: configmap shows `strip_org_tags: "true"` in the new release. ClickHouse query returns values for per-route metrics but aggregated tenant series (tag:tenant) have 0 rows. yea that matches.

julia_cs: customer says they're blocked — they use org-level SLOs. Any quick workaround to get p95/p99 back?

sam_runtime: short term: toggle config back to `strip_org_tags: "false"` on the proxy and roll forward. Command: `kubectl -n telemetry set env daemonset/telemetry-proxy STRIP_ORG_TAGS=false` then restart daemonset pods: `kubectl -n telemetry rollout restart daemonset/telemetry-proxy`. I'll prepare a patch.

kevin_oncall: patch applied, restarting pods now.

kevin_oncall: pods restarted. Waiting ~30s for metrics to flow.

kevin_oncall: confirmed — tenant-level series are showing up again and p95/p99 reappeared on org dashboard. Julia, can you confirm with ACME?

julia_cs: confirmed with customer — lines are back, they can see SLOs again. Customer appreciated the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

sam_runtime: root cause: default for tag remap flag flipped in v2.13.0; QA missed org-level aggregations because most internal dashboards use route-level. Action items: 1) revert default in chart, 2) add integration test for tenant-level metrics, 3) postmortem doc. Filing infra-incident-2312.

todd_support: adding a short note on the ticket for billing/alerts teams — some on-call SLO alerts may have been noisy while metrics were missing.

kevin_oncall: thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the incident ticket with timelines and the exact k8s diff.

julia_cs: closing loop with ACME and moving to incident. Ticket: INC-2312.
